title: Old Fashioned Spicy Russian Beef Stew
description: A spicy and snappy Russian dish featuring dried leaves of summer savory, perfect for curing hangovers. This low-carb-friendly stew is made with tender beef and a blend of aromatic spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef cubes and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the chopped onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the dried summer savory leaves, beef broth, tomato paste, hot sauce, salt, and black pepper to the pot.
Stir to combine and bring the mixture to a boil.
Return the browned beef to the pot and reduce the heat to low.
Simmer the stew, covered, for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Deglaze the pot with a little water and serve hot.
